<!-- LESSON_ACTIVE: template-task-infinite-loop -->
**Template Task Infinite Loop:** When plan.md includes a JSON task block as a "format example" (template),
prepare_context.py parses it as a real pending task. The agent picks it up
every iteration but can't complete it (it's not a real task), causing an
infinite loop of wasted iterations.

Observed in: comfyprompts — 8 iterations stuck on template task.
  Fix: 1. Template/example task blocks must be inside HTML comments (<!-- -->)
   so the JSON parser doesn't see them
2. OR the template must have "passes": true so it's filtered out
3. prepare_context.py should warn if a task has no meaningful description

<!-- LESSON_ACTIVE: credit-exhaustion-phantom-passes -->
**Credit Exhaustion Phantom Passes:** When the Claude API credit balance is too low, ralph loop iterations complete in <10 seconds with zero files changed, but gates pass vacuously (no code changed = nothing to fail). This creates observation records that look like clean runs but are actually no-ops. The agent never executed.
Observed in: alexa-prank (20 phantom iterations), spanish-study-games (20 phantom iterations), fsm-command-patterns (8 phantom iterations)
  Fix: 1. smart_gate.py should check if iteration duration was <10s AND files_changed == 0 — mark gate result as "skipped" not "pass"
2. ralph.sh should check Claude CLI exit output for "Credit balance" error and halt immediately instead of continuing through all iterations
3. metrics.jsonl tracks duration_s and output tokens — if output_tokens_est < 50, flag the iteration as a no-op
4. Alert system should fire on 3+ consecutive zero-file iterations

<!-- LESSON_ACTIVE: mark-phase-skipped -->
**Mark Phase Skipped:** The agent frequently completes work and commits but forgets to set
"passes": true in plan.md. This causes the next iteration to re-attempt
the same task, wasting cycles.

Observed in: AngryBirds (1x), DissonantDreams-Unity (1x), EventDesignedLearning (5x), campaign-finance-network (60x), comfyprompts (5x), flavor-network (60x), gym-mouse (32x), mod-my-week-platform (105x), murder-mystery (7x), prediction_betting (4x), ralph-universal (55x), unity-py-sim (16x)
  Fix: 1. PROMPT.md Phase 6 (Mark) must be bold with explicit "CRITICAL" warning
2. Manager review checks if the diff includes a passes:true change in plan.md
3. If the last commit message references a task but plan.md wasn't updated, flag it

<!-- LESSON_ACTIVE: repetition-murder-mystery-verify-project-setup-run-existing- -->
**Repetition Murder Mystery Verify Project Setup Run Existing :** Task repeated 5 times without progress in murder-mystery: Verify project setup — run existing tests, check dependencies, document baseline

Stuck task: Verify project setup — run existing tests, check dependencies, document baseline

Iterations: 1–5 (run consumed 5 loops with no plan progress).

Observed in: murder-mystery
  Fix: 1. Stop running the same task. After two consecutive iterations with no mark-phase commit, decompose into smaller subtasks in `plan.md` before the next attempt. Stuck task: `Verify project setup — run existing tests, check dependencies, document baseline`.
2. Inspect the last failing diagnose output (`smart_gate.py --diagnose`) and address the specific error the previous iteration produced — don't restart from scratch.
3. If decomposition isn't possible, escalate to a human. Three failed iterations is the budget; a fourth burns more API spend than rewriting the spec.
4. After applying any of the above, tag the commit message with `<lesson_applied stem='repetition-murder-mystery-verify-project-setup-run-existing-' how='N' />` where N is the step you used. This is how the corpus learns whether the lesson is actually working (see docs/bridge-protocol.md §4h).
